name: Wildlife Conservation Network Conservation Partners
summary: Long-term partnership offering fiscal sponsorship, flexible funding, fundraising and organisational support to locally led nonprofits working on threatened wildlife species. Organisations that meet the criteria can express interest and then go through a four-step vetting process.
reporting: Partners share financial and programmatic reports with WCN, starting during the onboarding process.

effort.quote: If your organization matches our criteria, reach out to [email protected] to express your interest in partnering with WCN.
The organization begins to share financial and programmatic reports with WCN.
WCN invites the organization to be a guest speaker at a WCN event and establishes a Fiscal Sponsor relationship to gather donations.
WCN conducts a site visit of the organization's conservation work and assesses their overall operations.
Upon input from WCN staff and existing Partners, WCN's Board of Directors approves of the new Partner.
